figures.caption: Table 1: Comparison of the Dual Head model (Ours) against the SimpleClick(without EDH) baseline (Base). Arrows indicate if lower (↓) or higher (↑) is better. The EDH consistently improves click efficiency (NoC) and enhances initial segmentation quality (mIoU@1) and boundary accuracy (NSDS).
Figure 3: Sample of U-CFR refinement. The input image (with a positive click) is processed to generate a prediction probability map and an initial binary mask.

Figure 1: Overview of the proposed Uncertainty-Guided Cascade Forward Refinement (U-CFR) framework. Userprovided clicks (middle left) are embedded into click maps and fused with the input image before entering a shared encoder-decoder backbone.
